blocks.text: CALAPAN CITY, Oriental Mindoro — Church and youth groups in Oriental Mindoro are urging young people to take a more active role in political reform, including efforts to end political dynasties. The call is part of the “Dapat Isa Lang” people’s initiative campaign, which seeks to raise awareness about political dynasties and encourage Filipinos to turn their political concerns into concrete action. As part of the campaign, the Diocese of Calapan Youth Commission and the Diocesan Social Action Center will hold a forum on political dynasties on Oct. 20 at 1 p.m. at the Divine Word College of Calapan Basic Education […]...
